functions.name: Tag
params:
{
  color = "default",
  size = "default",
  closable = false,
  checkable = false,
  checked: controlledChecked,
  defaultChecked = false,
  icon,
  visible: controlledVisible,
  bordered = false,
  pill = false,
  onClose,
  onCheck,
  onClick,
  className = "",
  style,
  children,
}

callGraph.callee:
[
    "tag",
    `tag-size-${size}`,
    isPredefinedColor && `tag-${color}`,
    bordered && "tag-bordered",
    pill && "tag-pill",
    checkable && "tag-checkable",
    checkable && checked && "tag-checked",
    closable && "tag-closable",
    isDark && "tag-dark",
    className,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join
